description.value:
Multi Shadow Clone Technique. Naruto's signature. You create a number of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllNjKageBunshn]{Kage Bunshin} equal to your spellcasting modifier, each with one-quarter your maximum HP (rounded down).

Casting this jutsu is taxing: you become fatigued until your next long rest after the clones dispel. Sage-mode or jinchūriki characters ignore the fatigue.

The clones share your spell-slot pool. Coordinated tactics are powerful; the GM may rule that two or more clones can Aid each other on the same Strike with the same flat-DC.

Heightened (8th) Clones have half your maximum HP each; you are no longer fatigued after dispersal.
